findings.claim: The new README section and MsgPack004 doc state that diagnostics for members of referenced-assembly types are reported by the defining assembly. findings.claim: ReportIfLocatedInCompilation wraps every analyzer diagnostic and silently drops any whose location is not in a syntax tree of the compilation. Diagnostics with Location.None are also dropped, so any existing diagnostic reported without a location is now suppressed (e.g. MemberNeedsKey, which previously could carry a null location). This could hide legitimate reports in the same assembly, and L10 warns that analyzer reporting changes risk wrong reports.

receipt_plan.detail: Run the full analyzer test suite (MsgPack003/004/005 etc.). Add a test where a same-assembly diagnostic is created with a null or None location and assert it is still reported; it fails if that diagnostic is dropped.

findings.claim: The MsgPack004 documentation says the analyzer only reports on members declared in the project being compiled. The README addition says 'any problem must be fixed there'.
